title: Towards the Right Kind of Fairness in AI
benchmark_measurement: The paper proposes a conceptual framework ('Fairness Compass') for selecting fairness metrics. It mentions 'religion' as a potential sensitive attribute for which bias could be measured, but does not conduct any specific measurements or benchmarks.
findings: The paper identifies 'religion' as a potential sensitive attribute for defining subgroups in fairness analysis, but does not present any specific findings related to religious bias.
